relationships.evidence_quote: While erenumab targets the CGRP-receptor (CGRP-R), galcanezumab and fremanezumab target the CGRP peptide [2, 3].

relationships.evidence_quote: While erenumab targets the CGRP-receptor (CGRP-R), galcanezumab and fremanezumab target the CGRP peptide [2, 3].

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results show a significant decline in headache impact and generic HRQoL of migraine patients after treatment discontinuation of a CGRP(-R) mAb.

key_findings: After stopping CGRP(-R) mAbs, HIT-6, EQ-5D-5L, PCS-12 and MCS-12 worsened significantly over 16 weeks; MMDs returned to pre-treatment levels.
HRQoL deterioration was more marked after erenumab than ligand mAbs, possibly due to shorter half-life.
